name: Rallye Sahara Draâ
description: Moroccan Sahara edition content (amendment A): fictional rally-raid event over real terrain character around Zagora and the Draâ valley. Event, teams, drivers, sponsors and routes are invented.
notices: Fictional event: no real rally-raid event, organiser, team, sponsor or person is depicted or endorsed.
Real place names are used for geography only.
